meta.name: Sharpen
meta.subtitle: A twenty-eight day challenge you take with one person.
meta.sourceNote: Shaped by Joe on 2026-09-09. The name, the three rest pathways, the rotating appreciation lines with a Customize option, and eight as the circle maximum are all his.
meta.voiceNote: Every string here is member-facing. Use affirmative construction, full word forms rather than contractions, and a period or comma where an em dash would sit.

agreements.title: Be impeccable with your word
agreements.line: Say what is true, and say it with care.
agreements.livesIn: Every appreciation line, and the prompt behind Customize.

agreements.title: Let what others carry belong to them
agreements.line: A quiet day in your circle speaks about their day, and it belongs to them.
agreements.livesIn: The rest pathways, and the choice to show presence rather than absence.

agreements.title: Ask, and say what is true for you
agreements.line: Speak your need out loud, so the people beside you can meet it.
agreements.livesIn: REACH OUT, where a member names what they want rather than leaving the circle to guess.

agreements.title: Always do your best
agreements.line: Your best looks different from one day to another, and each version of it counts.
agreements.livesIn: All three rest pathways. This agreement is the reason they exist.

restPathways.intro: Today, your best looks like one of these.

options.label: RESTORE
options.statement: I completed 15 minutes of restorative yoga, breathing, meditation, or gentle mobility.
options.description: A structured practice that honors the body while it recovers.
options.outcomeNote: A practice was done, so the day is complete and the shared count rises.

options.label: REST
options.statement: Resting is my best today, and I am honoring what my body needs.
options.description: Chosen rest, named out loud, held by the practice.
options.outcomeNote: Your streak stays whole, and your grace days stay exactly where they were. The circle sees a member who is resting, and it keeps their place.

options.label: REACH OUT
options.statement: I could use some encouragement, accountability, or inspiration from my circle today.
options.description: A raised hand, and an invitation for the circle to answer.
options.outcomeNote: Your streak stays whole, your grace days stay where they were, and the circle receives one invitation to respond.
options.circleResponse: I see you. I am with you. How can I support you today?

restPathways.confirmComplete: Your day is complete. This was a practice.
restPathways.confirmHeld: Today is honored. Your place is kept.
restPathways.capNote: Named rest days are part of this cycle, and you have honored all of them. Today a grace day holds your streak.

appreciation.rotationNote: Three lines surface each day, chosen by date so a member sees a fresh set rather than the same three every morning.

customize.label: Say it in your own words
customize.prompt: Offer encouragement that helps this person feel seen, heard, accepted, appreciated, and loved. Celebrate their effort, speak to who they are becoming, and invite their next step with love.
customize.helper: Your words, guided by the same intention.

lines: I see you showing up. That is who you are becoming.
Your effort today counts, and I am glad to be walking beside you.
You kept your word to yourself. That is real strength.
Today you chose yourself, and I am proud to be in your circle.
What you did today matters, and I noticed.
You are building something steady. Keep going.
Fifteen minutes, and you gave them fully. Well done.
I see the person you are practicing into being.
Your consistency is a gift to this circle.
You showed up, and that is the whole thing.
Thank you for being someone I can count on.
Every day you practice, you make it easier for the rest of us.
You honored your body today. That is wisdom.
I appreciate you, and I appreciate the work you are doing.
You are becoming the person you said you wanted to be.
Today you did your best, and your best is enough.
I am grateful to be sharpening beside you.
The way you keep returning says everything about you.
You brought your whole self today, and I saw it.
One more day, and one more piece of who you are.
You are steady, and steady carries far.
Your practice today is a quiet act of love for yourself.
I see your effort, and I honor it.
Tomorrow belongs to you as well. I will be here.

circle.sizeNote: Eight is the maximum. Intimacy is the foundation, connection is the bridge, community is the whole.
circle.bridgeLine: Each circle stays small, and each member is a bridge to the whole community.
circle.anchorLine: A member one cycle further along, who holds eight.

partner.restingLine: {name} is resting. Your circle keeps their place.
partner.offlineLine: Your circle updates when you are back online.

pairing.inviteLine: Share this code with one person you already know.
pairing.helper: Say it out loud, or send it in a text. It rests after a day.

restPolicy.policyNote: RESTORE is itself a fifteen minute practice, so it completes the day. REST holds the day and leaves the grace day intact, up to the cycle allowance, after which the existing grace rules apply exactly as they do today.
restPolicy.reachOutNote: REACH OUT stays out of the app until a real delivery channel exists, so a member hears that a raised hand was seen only when a person truly sees it. The channel arrives with the daily text on October 1. Turn this on the day a message can reach an anchor.
